SpecialThingFilterDef.label: corpses unsuitable for biomass extraction
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Non-organic corpses and corpses with artificial parts awaiting medical recovery.

RecipeDef.label: extract biomass from corpse
RecipeDef.description: Convert a whole organic corpse into raw biomass. Recovery is based on remaining biological material, with 25% additional biomass from organs, bones and hide. This bonus also applies to damaged bodies. Rotting corpses yield 50% and desiccated corpses 10% of fresh recovery, with a minimum of 1 raw biomass per eligible corpse. Processing work scales with remaining material; larger bodies benefit from batch efficiency. By default, 30% of work handles the body regardless of decay, while 70% scales with recovery. Rotting bodies therefore take 65% and desiccated bodies 37% of fresh processing time. Corpse timings can be changed under Raw Biomass in GeneFoundry's mod settings. Clothing and equipment are stripped before extraction; special butcher products such as horns and tusks are recovered using their body-part definitions. Corpses with installed artificial parts are temporarily excluded until medical recovery is implemented. Animal corpses are selected by default; other organic corpses require enabling them in the ingredient filter.
